name: custom_axis
description: A dual-scale spectrum plot with wavelength and frequency axes. Judge only content inside the plot; ignore tabs, headings, descriptions, buttons, controls, and other surrounding UI.

checks.expectation: One coherent spectrum plot is visible. Its axes, grid, and curve stay within the plot area without unintended overlap or clipping. Do not evaluate tabs or other content outside the plot.

Two distinct horizontal axes are visible below the plot: Wavelength (nm) increases from roughly 400 to 700 left-to-right, while Frequency (THz) decreases left-to-right. The axes may be close together. Fail only for visible physical overlap or overprinting of their lines, ticks, titles, or tick-label glyphs; do not infer overlap from proximity or aligned ticks. If separation is unclear at the screenshot resolution, report uncertain rather than fail.
A continuous emission spectrum with three clearly visible peaks is drawn against the Relative intensity axis, including a tallest central peak.

Within the plot, axis titles and tick labels are readable and free of clear raster corruption. They are intentionally small, normal-weight, and light gray; those typography and contrast choices are not defects. Fail only for concrete defects such as square pixel blocks, doubled glyphs, or severe stair-step edges that make plot text materially illegible. Do not compare plot text with headings, tabs, buttons, controls, or any text outside the plot. Normal antialiasing, small or low-contrast fonts, rotated text, and backend-specific softness are acceptable.
Axes, grid, tick labels, and curve are not blank, corrupted, clipped, or drawn outside their intended areas.
